title: Salep (Sahlab): Thick Hot Milk with Orange Blossom and Cinnamon
summary: A thick, creamy hot drink infused with orange blossom and vanilla, topped with cinnamon and pistachios.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Slurry
steps.text: Whisk 24 g cornflour with 3 tbsp cold water in a small bowl to a smooth slurry.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: In a saucepan, warm 960 ml whole milk, 40 g sugar and ⅛ tsp fine salt over medium heat, stirring, until it steams and small bubbles form at the edge.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk the slurry again and pour it into the milk in a thin stream, whisking all the time; keep whisking on medium-low until it thickens to the consistency of thin custard and coats a spoon, 3–5 min, being careful not to let it catch.

steps.title: Flavour
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in 2 tsp orange blossom water and 1 tsp vanilla; taste and add sugar if needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into mugs, dust with 1 tsp ground cinnamon and scatter 2 tbsp chopped pistachios; drink hot.

tips: Whisk the slurry into the hot milk in a thin stream to avoid lumps forming.
Keep the heat low during thickening to prevent the drink from catching on the bottom.
Adjust the sugar to your taste after adding the orange blossom water.
storage: Serve immediately whilst hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
